profile.bio: A representative gift buyer shopping for a partner or friend, attracted by the idea of gifting something to grow rather than just wear. Weighs the charm of a hand-painted tin and marigold seed against the risk of gifting something that does not yet exist and may arrive late. Trusts reliability and clear delivery more than scarcity.
profile.stance: Tentatively positive - loves the plant-growing gift idea but hesitant about delivery uncertainty, the 3-4 week wait and unknown refund policy; scarcity numbering matters little to them
